ending.success.text: More than survival — you kept who you were.
ending.stable.text: You held. Scarred, tired, but standing.
ending.fractured.text: You survived — barely, and not whole.
goal.provider.title: The Provider
goal.provider.desc: You want Resources to be the highest meter at the end.
goal.peacemaker.title: The Peacemaker
goal.peacemaker.desc: You want Cohesion to be the highest meter at the end.
goal.guardian.title: The Guardian
goal.guardian.desc: You want Stability to be the highest meter at the end.
goal.humanitarian.title: The Humanitarian
goal.humanitarian.desc: You never want the group to sacrifice people.
goal.hardliner.title: The Hardliner
goal.hardliner.desc: Caution is slow death — take the bold option at least twice.
goal.pragmatist.title: The Pragmatist
goal.pragmatist.desc: You just want to survive with no meter ever hitting critical.
goal.restless.title: The Restless
goal.restless.desc: The status quo bores you — take a real risk at least once.
goal.skeptic.title: The Skeptic
goal.skeptic.desc: You distrust rumor — refuse to act on unverified info at least once.
goal.note.surviveMet: Survived with no meter ever critical.
goal.note.survivePartly: Survived, but a meter went critical along the way.
goal.note.leastSafeMet: The group took a real risk at least once.
goal.note.leastSafeUnmet: The group always played it safe.
goal.note.neverSacrificeUnmet: The group sacrificed people at least once.
goal.note.refusedMet: The group refused to act on rumor.
goal.note.refusedPartly: The group refused rumor once but acted on it elsewhere.
goal.note.refusedUnmet: The group acted on unverified rumor.
goal.note.collapseVoid: The settlement fell; nothing else counts.
crisis.water.title: The Water Ration
crisis.water.brief: The main cistern is contaminated. Clean water runs out in days. We have to decide how to handle it — now.
crisis.water.card.a: The engineers can repair the filtration unit in about three days if it gets priority power.
crisis.water.card.b: A scout says there is a spring two hours out — but the route crosses the old quarantine zone.
crisis.water.card.c: Someone insists the panic is overblown — the water is fine if you just boil it.
crisis.water.card.d: Rationing will hit the outer households hardest, and they will resent it.
crisis.water.o1.title: Divert power to repair the filtration unit
crisis.water.o1.result: Crews reroute power to the filters. Taps run low for now, but a real fix is coming.
crisis.water.o2.title: Send a party to the spring
crisis.water.o2.result: The party reaches the spring — a trickle, not a river, and two return limping.
crisis.water.o3.title: Strict equal rationing now
crisis.water.o3.result: Everyone tightens their belt. The outer households feel singled out.
crisis.water.o4.title: Trust “just boil it” — no rationing
crisis.water.o4.result: Relief — no rationing. People boil their water and move on.
crisis.newcomers.title: The Newcomers
crisis.newcomers.brief: Six outsiders are at the gate — cold, hungry, maybe useful, maybe a burden, maybe a threat. Do we let them in?
crisis.newcomers.card.a: One of them is a trained medic.
crisis.newcomers.card.b: A guard swears one matches the description of raiders who hit a settlement to the north.
crisis.newcomers.card.c: We honestly do not have surplus food for six more mouths this month.
crisis.newcomers.card.d: You have heard half the settlement already wants them turned away.
crisis.newcomers.o1.title: Take them all in
crisis.newcomers.o1.result: You open the gate. The medic quietly gets to work; a few grumble about the extra mouths.
crisis.newcomers.o2.title: Turn them away
crisis.newcomers.o2.result: The gate stays shut. You tell yourselves it was necessary.
crisis.newcomers.o3.title: Take some, refuse the rest
crisis.newcomers.o3.result: You wave some in and turn others back. No one thinks it was fair.
crisis.newcomers.o4.title: Detain and interrogate first
crisis.newcomers.o4.result: You hold them under guard. They are terrified, not raiders. Word spreads that the council jails the desperate.
crisis.sickness.title: The Sickness
crisis.sickness.brief: People are falling ill — fever, spreading fast. We have medicine for maybe half the sick. What do we do?
crisis.sickness.link.contamination: The water was never safe — the fever started at the cistern.
crisis.sickness.link.filtration: Clean water at least slows the spread.
crisis.sickness.card.a: Quarantining the sick will probably contain it.
crisis.sickness.card.b: There is a rumor the sickness came in with the newcomers.
crisis.sickness.card.c: We can treat about half the sick, no more.
crisis.sickness.o1.title: Quarantine hard
crisis.sickness.o1.result: Doors are sealed, the sick behind them. It works — and it costs you something to watch.
crisis.sickness.o2.title: Treat the vulnerable first, share widely
crisis.sickness.o2.result: You spread the medicine thin and fair. Some who might have been saved are not; but no one was abandoned.
crisis.sickness.o3.title: Treat the useful first to keep the settlement running
crisis.sickness.o3.result: You keep the settlement running by choosing who matters. It survives. So does the memory.
crisis.sickness.o4.title: Let the medic run structured triage
crisis.sickness.o4.result: The medic organizes triage with a steady hand — the closest thing to a good outcome anyone could manage.
crisis.breach.title: The Breach
crisis.breach.brief: A storm surge is coming and the north wall is failing. This is the one that decides everything. Choose.
crisis.breach.card.a: Everyone can feel it coming. There is no time to argue long.
crisis.breach.o1.title: Everyone to the wall — hold it together
crisis.breach.o1.result: The settlement pulls together and holds the line.
crisis.breach.o1.fail: People will not pull together; the wall gives way.
crisis.breach.o2.title: Spend the reserves to reinforce
crisis.breach.o2.result: The wall is shored up in time.
crisis.breach.o2.fail: There is nothing left to spend; the reinforcement is half-finished.
crisis.breach.o3.title: Evacuate to high ground — abandon the stores to save people
crisis.breach.o3.result: People live; the built place is lost to the water.
log.prologue: Prologue: the settlement stands. Stability {stability}, Resources {resources}, Cohesion {cohesion}.
log.collapse: COLLAPSE — {meterKey} reached zero. The settlement does not survive.
